fields.anprAlertSound: Sound alert for a new car

tooltips.brandColor: Format #rrggbb. Tints the brand plate, the login stripe and accents; the main button stays the product colour.
tooltips.brandDocHeader: Legal or trade name on receipts and invoices. Falls back to the application name when empty.
tooltips.landingSiteUrl: The website that hosts the email unsubscribe page (unsubscribe.html). When empty the opt-out link points straight at the CRM.
tooltips.enabledModules: Available modules. Empty or removed — the matching API answers 403 and the tablet shows a notice. A signed licence will fill this list later.
tooltips.kioskIdleSeconds: Seconds without a touch before the tablet returns to the PIN screen.
tooltips.kioskSessionHours: How long a worker PIN sign-in stays valid on the server (also for sending offline actions).
tooltips.kioskPinMaxAttempts: After this many wrong entries the PIN is locked for a while.
tooltips.kioskRateLimitPerMinute: Click-spam guard: the most actions one tablet may send per minute.
tooltips.photoRetentionDays: How many days order photos are kept. Cleanup: bin/command purge-photos (and the daily job).
tooltips.anprAutoCreate: OFF by default. When on: a car read with high confidence that is already known and has no active order gets an order with its last service. In every other case an operator decides.
tooltips.anprMinConfidence: Below this (0–1) an event always waits for an operator.
tooltips.anprHighConfidence: From this value (0–1) the system may act on its own (when "create automatically" is on).
tooltips.anprDedupSeconds: The same plate on the same camera inside this window is one event.
tooltips.anprRetentionDays: After how many days snapshots are deleted. Guide: 30. CHECK WITH A LAWYER.
tooltips.anprEventRetentionDays: After how many days the event record (plate, time, camera) is deleted. Guide: 90. CHECK WITH A LAWYER.
tooltips.anprAccessLogDays: How long to keep the "who looked at pictures" journal.
tooltips.anprAlertSound: The board plays a short beep when a new car appears.
tooltips.camerasViewBase: Path or address where the reverse proxy publishes the go2rtc/Frigate viewer (default /cam).
tooltips.sourceCodeUrl: Address where the source code of THIS version is published (AGPL section 13). Shown as the "Source code" link in the footer and About. Required for a public or SaaS installation.
